LanguageData.VFEI2_ChemfuelSpew.description: Discharge a stream of liquid chemfuel from the mouth. This liquid, when released, can coat any object or individual it contacts, without igniting or causing immediate combustion. The chemfuel is synthesized and stored within a specialized organ in the neck area.
LanguageData.VFEI2_ChemfuelSpew.label: fuel spew
LanguageData.VFEI2_ChemfuelSpit.description: Titantick vomits a giant blob of burning chemfuel over a large distance.
LanguageData.VFEI2_ChemfuelSpit.label: chemfuel spit
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateLargeBurrow.description: Patriarch emits vibrations that cause the royal caste of insects to dig to the surface, creating a large burrow.
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateLargeBurrow.label: create large burrow
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateMediumBurrow.description: Patriarch emits vibrations that cause the royal caste of insects to dig to the surface, creating a medium burrow.
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateMediumBurrow.label: create burrow
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateSmallBurrow.description: Patriarch emits vibrations that cause the royal caste of insects to dig to the surface, creating a small burrow.
LanguageData.VFEI2_CreateSmallBurrow.label: create small burrow
LanguageData.VFEI2_FlameSpew.description: Eject a flow of adhesive, combustible fluid from the oral cavity. This fluid, upon contact, can set ablaze any target or create burning patches upon surfaces. It is produced and held within a gland located in the throat, accompanied by a distinct sac filled with a spontaneously igniting chemical, ensuring immediate combustion upon expulsion.
LanguageData.VFEI2_FlameSpew.label: flame spew
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectAcidSpew.description: Insectoid sprays a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectAcidSpew.label: insect acid spew
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectAcidSpit.description: Insectoid sprays a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectAcidSpit.label: insect acid spit
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Far.description: Insectoid does a wing-assisted jump to a very distant location using strong hind legs.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Far.label: insect farglide
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Medium.description: Insectoid does a wing-assisted jump to a location using strong hind legs.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Medium.label: insect glide
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Short.description: Insectoid does a wing-assisted jump to a close location using strong hind legs.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Short.label: insect shortglide
LanguageData.VFEI2_LargeAcidSpew.description: Insectoid sprays a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid deals damage over time.
LanguageData.VFEI2_LargeAcidSpew.label: large acid spew
LanguageData.VFEI2_WideTunnels.description: Insectoid charges towards the target, dealing significant damage to anything on the path. Will destroy any sort of defenses with ease.
LanguageData.VFEI2_WideTunnels.label: breacher charge
LanguageData.VFEI2_WideTunnels.verbProperties.label: wide tunnels
